pull.title: guix: update time-machine
pull.body:
Update time-machine to [5fe25a5142e744b134ccaa6d18e6d056e22b0c15](https://codeberg.org/guix/guix/commit/5fe25a5142e744b134ccaa6d18e6d056e22b0c15).

cmake `3.31.10` -> `4.3.3`
linux-libre-headers-6.1 `6.1.172` -> `6.1.187`
python-lief `0.17.6` -> `1.0.0`

Default Clang/LLVM updated to `22.x` and `23.x` available.
GCC 16 now available.

events.body: The following sections might be updated with supplementary metadata relevant to reviewers and maintainers. ### External sites * Code coverage & benchmarks: https://corecheck.dev/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/35855 * Ralph review https://git.fish.foo/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/35855#author-ralph ### Reviews See [the guideline](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review) and [AI policy](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/doc/AI_POLICY.md) for information on the review process. A summary of reviews will appear here. ### Conflicts Reviewers, this pull request conflicts with the following ones: * [#36082](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36082) (ci: add Guix builds to CI by willcl-ark) * [#35713](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35713) (Remove boost as a unit test runner by rustaceanrob) * [#25573](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/25573) (guix: produce a `-static-pie` bitcoind by fanquake) If you consider this pull request important, please also help to review the conflicting pull requests. Ideally, start with the one that should be merged first.
